title: Biologic DMARDs for Rheumatoid Arthritis
summary: Covers subcutaneous adalimumab for moderate to severe active Rheumatoid Arthritis following documented failure, intolerance, or contraindication to a 3-month trial of conventional synthetic DMARD (methotrexate, leflunomide, or sulfasalazine) and negative baseline tuberculosis screening.

sections.title: Indications for Biologic Therapy
sections.content:
Adalimumab (CPT J0135) is considered medically necessary for adult patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis when:
1. Diagnosis of moderate to severe active Rheumatoid Arthritis established by rheumatologist (based on swollen/tender joint count, elevated ESR/CRP, positive RF or anti-CCP antibodies).
2. Inadequate response to or intolerance/contraindication to at least one conventional synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (csDMARD), typically oral methotrexate at target doses (>= 15 mg/week) for at least 12 weeks.
3. Documentation of screening for latent tuberculosis infection (PPD skin test or IGRA / QuantiFERON Gold) with negative result prior to initiation.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.content: Concurrent use with other biologic DMARDs or targeted synthetic DMARDs (JAK inhibitors). Active serious systemic infection.

criteria.title: Moderate to Severe Active Rheumatoid Arthritis
criteria.description: Confirmed diagnosis of moderate to severe active RA with documented joint swelling, tenderness, and elevated inflammatory markers (ESR or CRP).
criteria.required_evidence: Rheumatology note confirming active RA, swollen joint counts, and elevated CRP/ESR.

criteria.title: Failure or Intolerance to csDMARD (Methotrexate >= 12 weeks)
criteria.description: Documented trial of at least 12 weeks of methotrexate (or other csDMARD like leflunomide) at therapeutic dosage with inadequate disease suppression or documented hepatotoxicity/intolerance.
criteria.required_evidence: Medication history recording >= 12 week trial of methotrexate with dates and lack of response or side effects.

criteria.title: Negative Latent Tuberculosis Screening
criteria.description: Documented negative TB screening test (QuantiFERON-TB Gold or PPD) within the prior 12 months.
criteria.required_evidence: Laboratory or clinical note citing negative QuantiFERON Gold or negative PPD test.

criteria.title: Absence of Active Serious Infection or Biologic Duplication
criteria.description: No active untreated serious infection and no concurrent administration of another biologic or JAK inhibitor.
criteria.required_evidence: Review of systems confirming absence of active infection and singular biologic regimen.
